Advertisement for Faculty
Thursday, 16 May 2019
30978 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society invites applications for the following posts.
1. Professors in Biochemistry (open-1), TB & Chest (open-1), Psychiatry (open-1),
2. Associate Professors in Pathology (SC-1), Gen. Medicine (SC-1, ST-1), Surgery (SC-1 & ST-1), Orthopaedics (ST-1) ENT (open-1), Obst & Gynae (ST-1), Anaesthesiology (SC-1), Radiodiagosis (SC-1), Radiotherapy (open-1)
3. Assistant Professor in Pathology (SC-1 & open-1), Community Medicine (SC-1, VJ/NT-1), Paediatrics (ST-1), Gen. Medicine (SC-1, ST-1, VJ/NT-1, open-2), TB Chest (open-1), Skin & VD (open-1), Surgery (ST-1 & VJ/NT-1), Orthopaedics (VJ/NT-1), Ophthalmology (ST-1 & open-1 ), ENT (ST-1),  Obst. & Gynae (ST-1, VJ/NT-1, open-2) & (1 open –Lect. Cum M& CWO & 1 open Lect cum AMO) , Anaesthesiology (ST-1 & open-1), Radiodiagnosis (ST-1), Dentistry (open-1), Radiotherapy (SC-1)
The applicant should send their applications along with complete bio-data with necessary academic experience  certificates/testimonials for the above posts to the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram. Dist. Wardha (MS) till
27/05/2019
. The appointments would be temporary for next two academic years or till the next regular Selection Committee of MUHS meets whichever is earlier and as per MUHS direction 1/2017.
Qualification
: MBBS with MCI recognized Post-graduate Degree in concerned subject.
Experience
: As per MCI and MUHS norms
Pay Scale
: As per the rules of Kasturba Health Society
For more details please contact:
